content.text: I'll calculate the impact of a 5% price increase on churn using the example plan.

The tool shows revenue and margin impact but doesn't model churn elasticity—that requires external pricing strategy data. A 5% price increase raises monthly revenue from 51000 cents to 53500 cents [E1], but churn response depends on your customer segment, competitive positioning, and willingness-to-pay. To forecast churn impact, you'd need to input a churn rate assumption (e.g., 200 bps baseline) and model how price sensitivity affects it. What churn elasticity or customer segment data do you have?
